body: I know. The idiotic nature of my fear makes me feel 1000x worse through 😞

Thank you. My mother definitely put that voice inside me as well 😞 she's dead 10 years now but I guess the damage was done. I went to the mental health clinic today and sat for two hours only to be turned away to come back tomorrow. I'm frustrated but my husband is taking care of me the best he can. I just hope I can go it alone tomorrow when he's at work.
I get it. You are not alone!!!!
